join hortbot 2 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test."
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "This is a test." added as quote #1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote get 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #1: "This is a test."

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote delete 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #1 has been deleted.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test."
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "This is a test." added as quote #1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote get 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #1: "This is a test."


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test, part 2."
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "This is a test, part 2." added as quote #2.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote get 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #2: "This is a test, part 2."


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote remove 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #1 has been deleted.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote get 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #2: "This is a test, part 2."


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote get 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #1 does not exist.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test, part 3."
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "This is a test, part 3." added as quote #3.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote get 3
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #3: "This is a test, part 3."

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote remove 4
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #4 does not exist.


handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote remove
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !quote remove <index>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote remove asd
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !quote remove <index>


handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 :!quote delete 1
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 access=subscriber :!quote remove 1
no_send
